<includeonly>{{#invoke:Infobox|main
|kind=dmz-form
|sep=,
|title={{#if:{{{title|}}}|{{{title}}}|{{#invoke:Labels|name}}}}
|image={{#invoke:Labels|image|{{{image|}}}}}
|caption={{{caption|}}}
|sections=Summary, General, Stats

|Summary=Quote
|Summary_nolabel=yes
|Quote_nolabel=yes
|Quote={{#if:{{{quote|}}}|''{{{quote}}}''}}

|General=Race, Group, Form type, Requirements
|General_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|General}}
|Race_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Race}}
|Group_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Group}}
|Form type_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Form type}}
|Requirements_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Requirements}}

|Stats=Multiplier, Drain, Mastery
|Stats_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Stats}}
|Multiplier_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Multiplier}}
|Drain_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Drain}}
|Mastery_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Mastery}}
}}[[Category:Forms{{#translation:}}]]</includeonly><noinclude>{{Documentation}}</noinclude>
